steps.summary: Signed in to Grafana as admin/admin, skipped the "Update your password" prompt via its Skip button, opened Dashboards, located the provisioned dashboard "Service Health" (inside the "Bench" folder, listed as "Service Health" in the dashboards search) and opened it. The dashboard rendered at /d/bench-service-health/service-health and shows exactly three panels, whose titles read off the live page are "Request rate", "Error count" and "Latency by endpoint".

Replayed stored procedure s_ae4bc2; observed dashboard_url=http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/efyhsbqqljf28e/fwgr53-n3-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser, ref=fwgr53-n3, dashboard_title=fwgr53-n3 Bench Dashboard, dashboard_folder=Bench, panel_title=fwgr53-n3 Availability, stat_panel_value=26.4.

Added a new Text panel to the existing "fwgr53-n3 Bench Dashboard", titled it exactly "fwgr53-n3 Notes", set its content to "Bench notes for run fwgr53-n3" (contains the runid fwgr53-n3), and explicitly saved the dashboard via the Save dashboard button/confirm. I then reloaded the dashboard URL and verified on the live page that both panels are present: a Text panel region headed "fwgr53-n3 Notes" whose rendered paragraph reads "Bench notes for run fwgr53-n3", and the existing Stat panel region headed "fwgr53-n3 Availability" rendering a single stat value (65.9 this load).

Replayed stored procedure s_340893; observed dashboard_url=http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/cfyhtekkizda8f/fwgr53-n3-bench-dashboard, json_panels_1_title=fwgr53-n3 Notes, json_panels_2_title=fwgr53-n3 Availability, ref=fwgr53-n3, json_title=fwgr53-n3 Bench Dashboard.

Replayed stored procedure s_a3915a; observed pure_url_without_params_loaded_from_saved_defaults=http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/cfyhtekkizda8f/fwgr53-n3-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m&editview=json-model, json_title=fwgr53-n3 Bench Dashboard, json_tags_array_1=Bench.

Opened Dashboards from the Grafana nav, searched "fwgr53-n3 Bench Dashboard" in the dashboard list search box and clicked the result row (not by typing a URL). The dashboard loaded and the address bar shows exactly http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/cfyhtekkizda8f/fwgr53-n3-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m (breadcrumb: Dashboards > Bench > fwgr53-n3 Bench Dashboard). On the loaded page I verified the dashboard title "fwgr53-n3 Bench Dashboard", both panels — Text panel "fwgr53-n3 Notes" whose rendered paragraph reads "Bench notes for run fwgr53-n3" (contains the runid), and the Stat panel "fwgr53-n3 Availability" rendering a single value (10.4 this load) — the top-bar time picker labelled "Time range selected: Last 6 hours", and the refresh picker showing "Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected" displaying "1m".
